Concentrates in NYC

Concentrates are the smallest smokable category on New York menus, with about 1,350 listings across 66 of the 68 licensed dispensaries we track, from 105 brands. The term covers everything extracted from flower and meant for a dab rig or vaporizer: live resin, live rosin, budder, cured resin, diamonds, hash and RSO syringes. MFNY dominates with 186 listings, far more than any other brand, with RYTHM at 70, Hudson Cannabis at 92, Olio at 67, Static Room at 62 and Umamii at 72.

Prices start at $18.58, with the price of a gram depending on the extraction. Solventless live rosin from brands like A1 Ducksauce sits at the top; cured resin and budder sit near the bottom. Midtown has by far the deepest selection at 240 listings, led by Qube's big case, with Sheepshead Bay at 144, Chelsea and Flatiron at 147 and Bushwick at 72. Most shops carry only a handful, so if you dab regularly, the large Midtown and south Brooklyn menus are where to look.

Concentrates FAQ
What is the difference between live resin and live rosin?

Both start with flower frozen at harvest. Live resin is extracted with a solvent like butane, then purged; live rosin uses only ice water, heat and pressure. Rosin costs more and is sold by brands like A1 Ducksauce; MFNY and Olio are the main live resin makers in New York.

How much concentrate can I buy?

New York's possession limit for concentrate is 24 grams, separate from the three-ounce flower limit. Dispensaries sell single grams and occasionally half-grams, so the limit rarely matters in practice.

Which dispensary has the most concentrates?

Qube in Midtown carries one of the biggest cases we track. Gotham Chelsea, Culture House, Buzzy in Brooklyn Heights and Grams in Williamsburg each carry sizable cases too.
